items.prompt: Sort the words by their vowel team.
hints: Look at the middle of each word.
Find the two vowels that go together.
Read rain. Which two vowels are in the middle?
items.explanation: Rain, tail and snail have ai. Feet, seed and green have ee.

figure.alt: The moon in the night sky.

items.prompt: Match each word to its vowel team.
hints: Look at the vowel letters in each word.
Some teams have two letters. One has three.
Start with tail. Which two vowels are next to each other?
items.explanation: Tail has ai, feet has ee, high has igh, coat has oa and food has oo.

items.prompt: Write the word for this picture.
hints: Say the word slowly.
It ends with a long e sound.
The first two sounds are t and r.
items.explanation: Tree is spelt t, r, ee. The long e at the end is ee.

items.prompt: Choose the missing word. 'The ___ is in the night sky.'
hints: Read the sentence with each word.
Think about what you can see at night.
Try each word in the gap. Which one makes sense?
items.explanation: The moon is in the night sky. Boat and soap do not make sense here.

options.why: A boat is on the water.
Soap is in the bathroom.

items.prompt: Change the first letter of 'goat'. Make something that floats on water.
hints: Keep oat at the end.
Think of things that go on water.

items.explanation: Goat with b at the start is boat. A boat floats on water.

options.why: You wear a coat. It does not float on water.

items.prompt: I have ee in my name. You have two of me at the end of your legs. What am I?
hints: Look at your legs. What is at the very end?
The word has ee in it.
Point to the end of your leg and say the word.
items.explanation: Feet are at the end of your legs. Feet has ee in the middle.

options.why: Knees are in the middle of your legs.
Toes have oe, and you have ten of them.
Teeth are in your mouth.
